summary: Total Source Logistics (DBA TSL) is a Northeast regional carrier running port drayage, LTL/TL, transloading, cross-docking and dedicated-distribution services off an Avenel dock and a 26,000 sq ft US-bonded CFS near Port Elizabeth. FMCSA records show 17 power units, 12 drivers and about 800,000 miles reported for 2025, with an active for-hire interstate authority (MC-320588) and a Satisfactory safety rating. Customer contact runs through a single toll-free number, a dispatch email and a generic web form, with a driver application form on the site and no evidence of an online quote, booking or ATS tool.

facts.fact: Service lines are drayage, transloading, container services, LTL, TL and dedicated distribution, with the LTL division serving NJ, the five NYC boroughs, Long Island, Rockland County NY and Philadelphia proper off the Avenel NJ dock.

Operates a 26,000 sq ft warehouse with 3 tailgates, 1 drive-in and over 2 acres of truck parking, described as a US bonded facility and Container Freight Station (CFS) about one mile from the Port of Elizabeth; the site gives the address as 629 Henry Street, Elizabeth, NJ.
Fleet consists of 12'-16' box trucks, lift-gate equipped 24'-26' straight trucks, tandem and single-axle tractors and trailers, plus access to 400+ additional units through partners.
Company states it uses Portpro intermodal TMS software plus Verizon for real-time GPS tracking, web-based tracking, signature capture and P.O.D. reporting.

Public contact path is a toll-free number (1-888-875-1011), the email dispatch@totalsourcelogistics.com and a three-field contact form with a math captcha; quotes are described as 'call today for a free, no obligation quote' rather than an online quote tool.
A 'Client Portal' link in the main navigation points to https://www.lpagrouponline.net/clientportal, a hostname that does not resolve.

The only hiring-related page on the site is a static 'Drive Application' page replicating a paper DOT driver application (employment history, FMCSR/drug-test history, accident and violation tables, references); there is no careers listings page and no applicant tracking system visible.

FMCSA SAFER snapshot for USDOT 691684 / MC-320588 (DBA TSL) shows 17 power units, 12 drivers, 800,000 miles reported for 2025, an MCS-150 dated 02/17/2026, active authority for motor carrier of property, and cargo including general freight, intermodal containers, liquids/gases and chemicals.
FMCSA lists the physical address as 86-110 Orchard Street, Hackensack NJ 07601, phone (732) 404-8800, and a mailing address at 629 Henry Street, Avenel NJ 07201.

FMCSA shows 12 US roadside inspections in the 24 months to 11/09/2026, vehicle out-of-service rate of 33.3% versus a 22.26% national average, zero reportable crashes, and a Satisfactory (non-ratable) safety rating with a 03/04/2026 review date.

New Jersey company record (entity ID 0400486262) shows Total Source Logistics, Inc. formed 2012-04-16, status Active, registered address in Avenel NJ, with Mark Silverstein listed as registered agent.
No current job postings were surfaced for the company: an exact-phrase search on SimplyHired returned zero results.

operations_signals: Intake is phone- and email-first: one toll-free line plus dispatch@ email and a three-field web form with a math captcha; nothing captures structured quote data such as lane, weight, commodity or accessorials (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/).
Quoting is explicitly human: the site repeatedly invites a call for a 'free, no obligation' quote for LTL, transloading and cross-dock work (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/).

Two physical nodes to coordinate: an Avenel NJ LTL dock and a 26,000 sq ft bonded CFS/warehouse addressed at 629 Henry Street (site says Elizabeth NJ; FMCSA mailing address says Avenel NJ 07201) (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/, https://safer.fmcsa.dot.gov/query.asp?searchtype=ANY&query_type=queryCarrierSnapshot&query_param=USDOT&original_query_param=NAME&query_string=691684&original_query_string=TOTAL%20SOURCE%20LOGISTICS%20INC).

Site claims management staff are reachable 24/7 and that on-site management oversees routing, dispatching, cubing and loading, implying after-hours coverage is handled by staff phones rather than a self-service channel (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/).
No published business hours, holiday schedule or online booking/scheduling anywhere on the site (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/).
Warehouse value-add work (strip, sort, palletize, wrap, cross-dock) is quoted per job, suggesting manual estimating for transloading projects (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/).
Driver onboarding is a paper-style application form on the website, with no upload portal or scheduling of interviews (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/driver-application/).
hiring_signals: No live job postings found: exact-phrase SimplyHired search returned zero results, and a talent.com query returned only unrelated NJ logistics listings (https://www.simplyhired.com/search?q=%22Total+Source+Logistics%22, https://www.talent.com/jobs?k=Total+Source+Logistics&l=).

The site maintains a standing driver application page rather than role-specific postings, which suggests continuous driver recruiting through an unfiltered web form (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/driver-application/).

FMCSA reports 12 drivers and 17 power units, so any dispatcher, billing or CSR function is a small shared back office covering a fleet that logged about 800,000 miles in 2025 (https://safer.fmcsa.dot.gov/query.asp?searchtype=ANY&query_type=queryCarrierSnapshot&query_param=USDOT&original_query_param=NAME&query_string=691684&original_query_string=TOTAL%20SOURCE%20LOGISTICS%20INC).
review_themes: No public customer reviews were found or retrievable: a review-aggregator page for the domain had zero reviews, and Google, Yelp, BBB, Trustpilot, Indeed, LinkedIn and Facebook all blocked automated reading (https://www.sitejabber.com/reviews/totalsourcelogistics.com).
Absent review volume is itself a signal that demand comes through brokers, 3PLs and cartage customers rather than consumer search (https://www.sitejabber.com/reviews/totalsourcelogistics.com).
tech_footprint: WordPress site on the Divi theme, built by Nu-Image Design, with Contact Form 7 loaded and a footer copyright of 2022 — content and design look unrefreshed since then (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/).
Portpro intermodal TMS and Verizon GPS tracking feed customer-facing tracking, signature capture and P.O.D. reporting; this is the main systems integration point (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/).
The navigation's 'Client Portal' link is broken — the hostname lpagrouponline.net does not resolve — so customers have no working self-service portal (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/).
No live chat, chatbot, online quote calculator, booking widget, scheduling tool or careers portal exists on the site (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/).
No blog, case studies, rate data or downloadable forms/PDFs beyond the HTML driver application (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/driver-application/).
The site publishes a single generic contact form whose fields are name, email and message only, with a simple arithmetic captcha (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/).
growth_signals: Company has operated since at least April 2012 and remains active, giving roughly 14 years of continuous trading (https://www.bizapedia.com/nj/total-source-logistics-inc.html).

An MCS-150 update filed 02/17/2026 with 800,000 miles reported for 2025 indicates current, actively maintained operating data (https://safer.fmcsa.dot.gov/query.asp?searchtype=ANY&query_type=queryCarrierSnapshot&query_param=USDOT&original_query_param=NAME&query_string=691684&original_query_string=TOTAL%20SOURCE%20LOGISTICS%20INC).

Cargo authority spans general freight, intermodal containers, liquids/gases and chemicals, plus a bonded CFS, which points to serving importers and chemical/liquid shippers through the Port of NY/NJ (https://safer.fmcsa.dot.gov/query.asp?searchtype=ANY&query_type=queryCarrierSnapshot&query_param=USDOT&original_query_param=NAME&query_string=691684&original_query_string=TOTAL%20SOURCE%20LOGISTICS%20INC).
Site advertises access to 400+ partner units to absorb volume swings, an asset-light flex model rather than owned-fleet growth (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/).
No expansion, award or new-location announcements were found in public sources, and the website shows no news section (https://totalsourcelogistics.com/).
decision_maker: Unknown — the company website has no team, about or leadership page, and the only individual named in accessible public records is Mark Silverstein as registered agent in the NJ company filing, with no owner/GM title confirmed (https://www.bizapedia.com/nj/total-source-logistics-inc.html)

inferences.inference: Dispatch and customer service are likely the bottleneck functions, staffed by very few people relative to volume.
inferences.reasoning: FMCSA shows only 12 drivers and 17 power units, yet the company runs an LTL network, port drayage, a bonded CFS and a cross-dock across two sites with 800,000 reported miles; the site says management personally covers routing, dispatching and cubing, which concentrates coordination in a small team.

inferences.inference: Safety and maintenance compliance is probably tracked manually or reactively.
inferences.reasoning: FMCSA's 24-month data shows a 33.3% vehicle out-of-service rate against a 22.26% national average, which typically reflects inspection-readiness and preventive-maintenance tracking gaps rather than an absence of policy.

inferences.inference: Quote turnaround is call-dependent and not measured, so inbound quote requests likely queue behind phone work.
inferences.reasoning: Every service page routes to the phone number and the only web form captures name, email and message, so no lane or shipment data is collected before a rep engages.

inferences.inference: Driver recruiting leaks applicants because the intake is a static form with no acknowledgement or tracking.
inferences.reasoning: The only hiring artifact is a long DOT-style application page with no careers listings, no ATS and no confirmation flow, and no job postings appear on the major boards searched.

inferences.inference: Digital investment has lagged and the customer portal project appears stalled.
inferences.reasoning: The site carries a 2022 copyright and Divi 4.9.7, publishes no hours or service-area detail, and the navigation's client portal points to a domain that no longer resolves.

data_gaps: Owner, president or GM name and title could not be confirmed: no leadership page on the site, and LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, Indeed and Glassdoor blocked automated access.

Employee headcount unverified — the mapper's ~22 figure comes from ZoomInfo, which returned HTTP 403 and could not be independently checked; FMCSA's 12 drivers and 17 power units are the only verified size indicators.
No customer reviews could be read: Google Maps, Yelp, BBB, Trustpilot, Indeed and Facebook all blocked fetching, and the one accessible aggregator had zero reviews.
No job postings found on SimplyHired (0 results), talent.com (unrelated results), Indeed, LinkedIn Jobs or ZipRecruiter (all HTTP 403), so recent hiring history is unknown.
Business hours, after-hours answering coverage and holiday schedule are not published.

The site states the 26,000 sq ft facility is in Elizabeth NJ while FMCSA lists 629 Henry Street as Avenel NJ 07201 and a separate Hackensack NJ physical address; which site is the operating dock versus a registered office is unresolved.
No information found on revenue, customer concentration, insurance limits, or 3PL/broker relationships beyond generic claims of 'strong partnerships'.
